CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the Salesforce EmailTemplate the confirmation Flow uses to build the email sent when a new submission is received. Resolved at send time (falls back to a source-resolved template if present). Requires Send Confirmation Email enabled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the Developer Name of the Salesforce email template used for the confirmation email sent after a submission. Set the template's object type to Form Submission so its merge fields resolve, or leave blank to use the package's default confirmation body.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Confirmation)
